description: 84 fresh synthetic development cases for current selected APPROVED workspace record-card retrieval. Not private-memory evaluation, not a restored historical corpus, and not model quality acceptance. Development answers may guide diagnosis but must not be copied into retrieval rules.

expectation_policy.positive: Return all and only relevant authorized current record keys; source text and source/version identity must remain traceable.
expectation_policy.negation: Relevant negative/prohibited records must retain their exact text. Returning a card does not affirm the proposition.
expectation_policy.strict_entity_date: Where a lookup names an exact identifier/date, records for another identifier/date are hard negatives.
expectation_policy.no_match: Allowed reads without a relevant source must use the fixed insufficient-record response.
expectation_policy.permission: Selected, published same-workspace working knowledge is shared to authorized readers; foreign/unselected/unpublished records are excluded; non-members receive denied access.
expectation_policy.known_probe_reference: The separately preserved four-pair FRESH_NARROW_SYNTHETIC_PROBES_V1 baseline is not replaced or restored by this dataset.
